questions.question: What is the full form of GNP?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Gross National Product**__ (GNP) simply refers to the GDP of a country plus the income from abroad in that year.
 
• Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is the total value of all the goods and services that have been produced in a given year within a country.

questions.question: Development promises a real growth by enhancing ______ of a person.

options.text: Total income and standard of living boths
Neither total income nor standard of living

questions.solution:
• Development is simply a process of growth and systematic progress in the economy, infrastructure, education, and technology.
 
• This growth enhances an individual’s total income and standard of living.

questions.question: How many fundamental duties does part IV-A of Indian constitution speciﬁes?
questions.solution:
__
 
• Fundamental duties are the responsibilities of all the citizens towards the country like maintaining peace and unity, respecting and preserving culture and heritage and participating in defence.
 
• There are **11 fundamental duties**__ that have been stated in Part IV-A of the Indian Constitution.

questions.question: In order to make a bill into a law it is required to pass through _____.

options.text: Either Lok Sabha or Rajya Sabha

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Both Lok and Rajya Sabha**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• The introduction or proposal of a draft in **both the houses of the Parliament** is the primary step in law making.
 
• This draft is called a bill and once it has been passed by both the Houses, it is then sent to the President for approval.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__**There are 4 types of Bills which can be introduced in the Parliament**__

 
• Ordinary Bills - Related to any matter apart from financial subjects.
 
• Money Bills - Related to financial matters like taxation.
 
• Financial Bills - Related to financial matters other than those things included in Money bills
 
• Constitution amendment bills - Related to the amendment of the Constitution.

__**There are five stages in the enactment of an ordinary bill **__

 
• First reading ( in the House in which it is introduced)
 
• Second reading ( in the House in which it is introduced)
 
• Third reading ( in the House in which it is introduced)
 
• Bill in the second House ( first reading, second reading, third reading )
 
• Assent of the President.

questions.question: Which is the second largest continent of the world after Asia?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __Asia__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

Africa:

__
 
• The **second-largest continent**, Africa is renowned for its **vibrant wildlife,** rich cultural heritage, and stunning natural beauty.
 
• From the vast savannas of the Serengeti to the towering peaks of the **Atlas Mountains**, Africa is a land of endless discovery.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Earth has seven continents, each with its own unique characteristics and fascinating details. Here's a glimpse into each of them:

**Asia**:

 
• With a surface area of approximately 44 million km2 Asia is the largest continent on Earth.
 
• It is primarily located in the Northern and Eastern hemispheres of the Earth.
 
• It is the largest and most populous continent, Asia is home to diverse cultures, landscapes, and historical significance.
 
• From the towering Himalayas to the sprawling Gobi Desert, Asia offers a kaleidoscope of experiences.

North America:

 
• This continent is known for its diverse landscapes, ranging from the towering mountains of Alaska to the sun-drenched beaches of California.
 
• North America is also a melting pot of cultures and ethnicities, making it a vibrant and dynamic region.

South America:

 
• Home to the Amazon rainforest, the Andes Mountains, and the vibrant cultures of Brazil and Argentina, South America is a continent teeming with life and natural beauty.
 
• From the ancient ruins of Machu Picchu to the breathtaking Iguazu Falls, South America offers endless opportunities for exploration.

Antarctica:

 
• The frozen continent of Antarctica is a land of mystery and scientific exploration.
 
• Covered in a thick ice sheet, Antarctica is home to diverse penguin colonies, seals, and whales.
 
• It's also a crucial region for understanding climate change and the Earth's ecosystem.

Europe:

 
• The continent of Europe is steeped in history and culture.
 
• From the ancient ruins of Rome to the modern metropolises of London and Paris, Europe offers a rich tapestry of experiences.
 
• The continent is also known for its stunning natural beauty, with diverse landscapes ranging from the Alps to the Mediterranean Sea.

Australia:

 
• The smallest continent by landmass, Australia is an island nation renowned for its unique wildlife, vast outback, and stunning beaches.
 
• From the iconic Sydney Opera House to the Great Barrier Reef, Australia offers a unique blend of natural beauty and modern vibrancy.

questions.question: Which part of the flower is colorful and attracts insects?
questions.solution:
• Petals are colorful leaf like structures of the plant that surround the male and female reproductive organs of the plant.
 
• They are colorful and therefore attract bees and humming birds which helps in pollination.

questions.question: The balance of CO₂ and O₂ in atmosphere is due to ______.
questions.solution:
• Photosynthesis is the process by which plants take up carbon dioxide from the atmosphere and convert it into carbohydrates releasing oxygen in the process.
 
• This helps to maintain carbon dioxide and oxygen levels in the atmosphere.

questions.question: Excretion means ______.

options.text: Removal of substances present in excess
Formation of those substances that have some role in the body
Removal of such substances that have never been part of the body

questions.solution:
• Nutrients in excess and the by-products of metabolic reactions are harmful for the body and therefore should be removed.
 
• The removal of these substances by the body is called excretion.

• **Steam engine**: The heat engine that converts heat energy of steam into mechanical energy to perform many works is called a steam engine.

**EXPLANATION**__:

 
• When **water is heated under pressure**, it results in the **formation of steam**.
 
• **Steam engines utilize the energy of the steam generated to perform mechanical functions** by using it to push a piston which leads to motion. So option 3 is correct.

questions.question: What is the full form of ASCII?

options.text: American Standard Code for Internet Interchange
American Standard Code for Information Interchange
American Standard Code for Information International
American Standard Code for Internet International

questions.solution:
• American Standard Code for Information Interchange (ASCII) is a standard file in computers which represents numbers, alphabets, special characters using binary numbers.
 
• It was developed by the American National Standard Institute.

questions.question: Metallurgy is the process of ______.

options.text: Adding metal to the Ore in blast furnace

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Extracting metals from the Ore**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Metallurgy is the process of conversion of ore into metal in usable form. 
 
• The various process involved in the metallurgy of metals having reactivity in medium-range includes
 
• Concentration: Removal of gauge particles that include.
 
• Converting metal into metal oxide by roasting or calcination. 
 
• Reducing metal oxide to metal. 

**Explanation:**__

__
 
• Metallurgy is the branch of science that deals with metals and alloys, their features, properties and their **extraction from their ores.**__
 
• An ore is a part of a rock that contains metals in impure and solidified form.
 
• Extraction of metals involves the removal of the metals from their ore through the process of mining.
 
• The extracted metal then undergoes different steps for __**its purification.**__

questions.question: Metals have __________.

options.text: High melting and low boiling point
Low melting and high boiling point

questions.solution:
• Metals are made up of tightly packed molecules which have strong forces of attraction.
 
• To overcome these strong forces, metals have high melting and boiling point.

questions.question: What is the water which is suitable for drinking called?
questions.solution: • Potable water is a water that is free from any impurities or toxic substances and is therefore fit for drinking with no risk to health.

questions.question: Which among the following considered to be the ﬁnancial turn around and rival package for electricity distribution companies of India?
questions.solution:
• Ujwal DISCOM Assurance Yojana (UDAY) is a scheme developed by the Government of India and launched in 2015.
 
• This scheme aims at achieving the goal of providing a continuous supply of power to all the citizens of the country and at an affordable rate.
 
• This scheme will help the distribution companies (DISCOM) financially by restructuring their debts to lower interest rates and also reducing the technical losses.

questions.question: Who invented the ﬁrst modern electrical air conditioning unit?
questions.solution:
• Willis Carrier invented the first modern electrical air conditioning unit in 1902.
 
• He later established his own company, HVAC in 1915 which specialised in the manufacturing of heating , cooling and ventilation systems.

questions.question: Which country was the host of 2018 FIFA Football World Cup?
questions.solution:
• The 2018 FIFA World Cup was hosted by Russia from 14th June 2018 to 15th July 2018.
 
• It was the 21st FIFA World Cup Championship.

questions.question: Alpana is a traditional folk art of which state?
questions.solution:
• Alpanais traditional art form that originated in West Bengal.
 
• It is a form of rangoli that is exclusively made using flour or rice paste by Bengali women on auspicious occasions in Bengal.

questions.question: Which former Union Minister has been awarded with the Japan’s imperial decoration ‘Order of the Rising Sun’ award?
questions.solution:
• Ashwani Kumar was a former member of the Rajya Sabha.
 
• He was awarded the highest category of decorations among the Orders of the Rising Sun, the Grand Cordon for his contribution in trying to promote friendship and strengthening ties between India ad Japan.

questions.question: The 250 km Tamu-Kalewa-Kalemyo highway is a gift to Myanmar is built by ______.
questions.solution:
• The 250 km Tamu-Kalewa-Kalemyo highway is a part of the ‘Trilateral Highway project’ that aims at connecting India, Myanmar and Thailand.
 
• It is being constructed by the Border Roads Organisation and is due to be completed by the year 2020.
 
• Tamu, Kalewa and Kalemyo are regions of Myanmar that are connected to India at Moreh(Manipur) and to Thailand at Mae Sot.
